mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msa_task_sending_info ( task_processing_id, ctrl_cmd_sequence_id, request_control_command_id, task_connection_url, task_sending_control_command_param, task_sending_control_command, task_sending_time, task_sending_status, task_sending_identifier ) VALUES ( #{taskProcessingId}, #{ctrlCmdSequenceId}, #{requestControlCommandId}, #{taskConnectionUrl}, #{taskSendingControlCommandParam}, #{taskSendingControlCommand}, NOW(3), #{taskSendingStatus}, #{taskSendingIdentifier} )
mapper.select: SELECT request_control_command_id, ctrl_cmd_sequence_id FROM msa_control_command_sequence_info where sequence_identifier = (SELECT next_sequence_identifier FROM msa_task_sending_info tsi INNER JOIN msa_task_processing_info tpi ON tsi.task_processing_id = tpi.task_processing_id and tsi.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id = tpi.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id INNER JOIN msa_control_command_sequence_info csi ON tpi.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id = csi.ctrl_cmd_sequence_id and tpi.request_control_command_id = csi.request_control_command_id WHERE tsi.task_sending_identifier = #{taskSendingIdentifier})
